bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar has immense potential to emerge as major investment hub: Nitin Gadkari - ANI News
bihar_raw_news.content: Bihar has immense potential to emerge as major investment hub: Nitin Gadkari ANI | Updated: Oct 02, 2026 08:50 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel Patna ( Bihar ) [India], October 2 (ANI): Union Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari on Thursday highlighted Bihar 's expanding infrastructure, improved connectivity, skilled human capital and strengthening investment ecosystem, saying the state has immense potential to emerge as a major hub for industry, enterprise and innovation. Gadkari was addressing the Rising Bihar Investor Summit 2026, themed "The Emerging Investment Destination of India", in Patna in the presence of Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary. The Union Minister underlined the importance of infrastructure and connectivity in supporting Bihar 's economic transformation, saying the state's development of roads and other infrastructure can strengthen access to markets, facilitate industrial activity and create employment opportunities. The Centre has also assured support for infrastructure development in Bihar , with Gadkari highlighting the role of road connectivity in supporting investment and economic growth in the state. The Rising Bihar Investor Summit was organised at Hotel Taj City Centre in Patna and brought together policymakers, investors, industry leaders, entrepreneurs and other stakeholders to discuss the state's investment opportunities and industrial growth roadmap. The summit focused on Bihar 's emerging opportunities across sectors, including industry, energy and power, urban development and housing, roads and connectivity, agriculture and food processing, and IT and IT-enabled services. The event also showcased the state's investment incentives and industrial infrastructure. The Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Package 2025 provides fiscal benefits, subsidies and land concessions for eligible projects, while the state has highlighted more than 100 industrial areas as part of its efforts to attract investment. Gadkari said a prosperous and progressive Bihar would have an important role in advancing the vision of a Viksit Bharat, powered by investment, employment, infrastructure and inclusive economic growth. He emphasised that investment-led development, combined with infrastructure expansion and employment generation, could strengthen Bihar 's position in India's broader economic growth story. Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary, who was present at the summit, invited domestic and international investors to participate in Bihar 's development journey and assured them of government support. The state government has set an ambitious target of attracting investments worth Rs 5 lakh crore by November this year, according to the summit's official website. Choudhary has also highlighted infrastructure development, industrial expansion and employment generation as key priorities, while encouraging industries to establish manufacturing units in Bihar . The summit's investment-focused agenda included sectoral sessions, business-to-government and business-to-business meetings, policy and incentive showcases, industrial infrastructure presentations, startup and innovation initiatives, and district-level investment opportunities. (ANI)

national_raw_news.content: The Nation pays homage to the Father of the Nation Mahatma Gandhi on his 157th birth anniversary today. A Sarva Dharma Prarthana Sabha was held at Bapu’s Samadhi, Rajghat in the National Capital. President Droupadi Murmu attended the Sarva Dharma Prarthana this morning and paid floral tributes to the Father of the Nation. Vice President C P Radhakrishnan, Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, Union Housing and Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal, and Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta also paid tributes to Mahatma Gandhi at Rajghat. On the occasion of Gandhi Jayanti, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said that Mahatma Gandhi’s entire life is a beacon of truth, non-violence, compassion, and service. Sharing a social media post, Mr Modi noted that Bapu’s ideals will continue to pave the way for humanity in every era. He wished that the timeless message of Mahatma Gandhi keep guiding the countrymen towards a better society and a Viksit Bharat. The Nation also pays homage to former Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri on his 122nd birth anniversary today. He was born on 2nd October 1904 in Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Nagar, previously known as Mughalsarai in Uttar Pradesh. As a teenager, he joined India’s freedom struggle and participated in the Non-Cooperation Movement in 1921. Following Independence, Shastri held several important positions in Uttar Pradesh and later in the Union Government. Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid floral tribute to the former Prime Minister at his memorial, Vijay Ghat in the national capital this morning. Delhi Traffic Police has issued a traffic advisory in view of Gandhi Jayanti at Rajghat and the birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri at Vijay Ghat today. The Traffic Police informed that Special traffic arrangements will be in place in and around Rajghat, Ring Road and adjoining roads to facilitate the programme ensure smooth and safe movement of traffic and pedestrians. The traffic police informed that traffic may be regulated or diverted between 5 am and 11 am in the morning today. The affected routes include Ring Road: Rajghat to Salim Garh Y-Point towards ISBT Kashmirir Gate, Nishad Raj Marg and Raja Ram Kohli Marg. The traffic police advised the citizens to plan their journeys in advance and allow additional travel time. It also advised them to avoid the affected roads and stretches wherever possible prefer Delhi Metro and other public transport.

national_raw_news.content: The Ministry of Civil Aviation (MoCA) has initiated a series of reforms to make aviation security processes simpler and quicker for the people working at Indian Airports. Briefing the media on the Bureau of Civil Aviation Security (BCAS) Reforms to Improve Operational Efficiency and Ease of Doing Business in New Delhi, Civil Aviation Secretary Samir Kumar Sinha said that these sweeping changes aim to digitise workflows, making processes simpler, and transition towards accountability-driven governance while maintaining the highest security standards. The Ministry informed that BCAS has streamlined the security clearance framework by moving towards a category-and contract-agnostic security clearance which is applicable across the nine identified categories of aviation entities. It is proposed to remain valid for five years as part of these reforms. BCAS has also introduced a more structured and time-bound approach to security vetting of airport infrastructure. It emphasises obtaining and communicating all necessary clarifications at one stage, prescribed timelines at different stages and closer monitoring of pending cases. To transform the Aerodrome Entry Permit system the BCAS has initiated an end-to-end digital workflow to streamline the entire process. The system provides for online registration and application, document submission, digital scrutiny and verification, defined approval workflows and digital issuance, with facial biometric verification. The system is being implemented as a common platform across all 169 airports. The Ministry highlighted that these reforms are essential, as Indian has become world’s third-largest domestic aviation market with number of operational airports has grown from 74 in 2014 to 165 in July 2026. It has added that these reforms are part of the broader vision of Viksit Bharat @2047 and the effort to build a future-ready aviation security regulatory framework that can keep pace with a rapidly expanding aviation sector.

national_raw_news.title: HM Amit Shah pays tribute to Mahatma Gandhi on his 157th birth anniversary today
national_raw_news.content: Home Minister Amit Shah paid his obeisance to Mahatma Gandhi on his 157th birth anniversary today. In a social media post, Mr Shah said that Gandhi did not consider Swaraj merely as the goal of freedom, but as the foundation of self-respect and self-reliance. He added that with the belief that no nation can become great without being connected to its roots, Mahatma Gandhi established Swadeshi, one’s own language, one’s own culture, and cleanliness as the fundamental philosophy of Indian society. Mr Shah said he taught all through his life that when there is devotion in action and purity in thoughts, no goal is impossible. The Home Minister also offered salutations to former Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri on his 122nd birth anniversary. Mr Shah noted that Shastri elevated the nation’s food providers and border guardians to symbols of the country’s strength and pride with the proclamation of ‘Jai Jawan, Jai Kisan’. He added that the former Prime Minister’s resolute leadership in challenging circumstances and the bold decisions taken in the interest of the nation are etched in golden letters in India’s history. Further, the Home Minister underlined that the ideas of Lal Bahadur Shastri, who made simplicity a tradition, duty a spiritual practice, and national service the very essence of life, will forever guide the people of this country.
